title: Prayer Hands
look: He wears his bleached black W365ORLD hoodie, black snapback and dark sunglasses in every shot. Epic world-scale cinematography: drone sweeps, golden dust in the air, long lenses, volumetric god rays, anamorphic flares, IMAX-scale wides. Recurring motif: his two hands pressed together in prayer, raised to the sky.

perform: the STAR alone in a pitch black void, a single shaft of light from above, he slowly brings his hands together in prayer, extreme close-up
story: slow motion extreme close-up of two hands pressing together in prayer, dust particles floating in a beam of golden light
satellite view of planet Earth at night, city lights glowing, camera falls toward the surface through clouds
the STAR seen from behind on a cliff edge at dawn, hands together, the whole world spread out below him
